# Public suffix parser

`tldts.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of tldts 7.4.18 (MIT).
Source: https://github.com/remusao/tldts
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/tldts/-/tldts-7.4.18.tgz
Package integrity: `sha512-somxA8xKAUzlAxl0TX/jMSYIbRNFIVGnI96pVGJPeMc5BsHmfVXn6mOJT6U++ELnl04eGfzpfcEuZe8WiASkXg==`

Includes ICANN and private Public Suffix List rules. Used offline to bound optional browser cookie permissions, not to expand runtime execution scope. Retain the bundled license when updating. Update by replacing this exact upstream distribution and running the companion permission regression tests; no runtime download is used.
